title: 버스 정류장 안내 읽기: 이번 정류장은 어디예요?
objective: Read "이번 정류장은 ○○입니다" correctly, and tell 이번 (this stop) from 다음 (next stop).
summary: Read bus stop announcements aloud, including the sound changes in 정류장 and 입니다.

task.title: Read and sound out
task.line: Write the real sound in [ ], choose the right word, or answer in Korean.

words.exampleMeaning: Let's meet at the bus stop.

words.meaning: this (stop) — the one coming up now
words.exampleMeaning: I'm getting off at this stop.
I'm getting off at the next stop.
Does this bus go to City Hall?

letters.as: After an ㅇ final, ㄹ sounds like n: 'jeong-nyu-jang'.
A final moves into the next silent ㅇ. An ㅇ final stays.
ㅂ before ㄴ sounds like m: 'im-ni-da'.

exercises: Write how it really sounds in [ ]: ① 종로 ② 강릉 ③ 동래
Write how it really sounds in [ ]. Watch the ㅇ final: ① 남산은 ② 시청은 ③ 종점은
Write how it really sounds in [ ]: ① 갑니다 ② 탑니다 ③ 남산입니다
Choose 이번 or 다음: ① (The bus pulling in now is yours.) ____ 버스 타요. ② (This bus is full, so you will wait.) ____ 버스 타요.
Read the announcement and answer: 이번 정류장은 종로입니다. 다음 정류장은 시청입니다. ① Which stop is the bus at now? Answer in Korean. ② You are going to 시청. Do you get off at this stop or the next stop?
answers: ① [남사는] ② [시청은] (ㅇ does not move) ③ [종저믄]
① 종로 ② The next stop (다음 정류장)
